title: DepEd: Teacher who allegedly forced students to drink soda with saliva to get due process
summary: A teacher in Mapandan, Pangasinan who allegedly forced two students to drink a soda mixed with saliva will be given due process, Education Secretary Sonny Angara said Wednesday.
